title: FlexLine Repayment Term and Recent Draws
content:
**Schedule note — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** When a line is closed to new draws while a balance remains, months are taken off the term over which the balance is repaid according to the draws posted on the line in the last 3 months.

Draws totalling 50% of the credit limit or more take off 6 months; draws totalling less than that but more than 0.00 take off 3 months; no draw in the last 3 months takes off nothing; the trim never takes the term below 12 months.

Months are taken off the term only after any months are added to it, and a trim that would leave fewer than 12 months leaves 12.

*Definitions.* The draws counted are the draw entries posted on the line (the amounts drawn; draw-fee entries are not draws). The last 3 months are the entries dated after the same day of the month 3 months before the closing date. The credit limit is the line's credit limit on the closing date.

| Draws in the last 3 months, against the credit limit | Months taken off |
|---|---|
| 50% or more | 6 |
| more than 0.00, below 50% | 3 |
| none | 0 |

*Hypothetical boundary figures:* on a 7000.00 USD limit, draws totalling 3500.00 USD are exactly 50% and take off 6 months; 3499.99 USD takes off 3 months. A term of 15 months losing 6 months stands at 12, not 9.

*Hypothetical window:* for a closing on 15 June, a draw dated 16 March counts, and a draw dated 15 March does not.
